card.name: The word levels after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word "levels" right after a drug name such as lithium or theophylline, in interaction statements about blood concentrations rising.

modes.label: Lithium levels
modes.description: "levels" after "plasma lithium" in NSAID-lithium interaction text.
modes.example: NSAIDs have produced elevations in plasma lithium<< levels>> and reductions in renal lithium clearance.

modes.label: Other drug levels
modes.description: "levels" after another drug name such as theophylline in a serum-increase statement.
modes.example: Erythromycin use in patients who are receiving high doses of theophylline may be associated with an increase in serum theophylline<< levels>> and potential theophylline toxicity.

card.plain: It fires on the word "levels" when a drug interaction raises the blood concentration of a named drug, mostly lithium.
